questions.markdown: A step-index optical fiber has a core refractive index $=1.48$ and a cladding refractive index $=1.46$. The core radius of the fiber is $4\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ and the operating wavelength is $1550\,\mathrm{nm}$. Calculate the following: a) The critical angle for total internal reflection at the core-cladding interface. b) The numerical aperture (NA) of the fiber. c) The maximum acceptance angle in air.
Calculate the ratio of Einstein’s coefficients for a system at $300\,\mathrm{K}$ in which radiations of wavelength $1.39\,\mu\mathrm{m}$ are emitted.
How Davison and Germer experiment validated the de Broglie hypothesis? Explain.

questions.markdown: When a photosensitive metal is illuminated by light of certain wavelength, the stopping potential required to stop the ejected photoelectrons was found to be $1.1\,\mathrm{V}$. If the incident wavelength is half the threshold wavelength of the metal, find (a) threshold frequency, (b) work function of the metal and also (c) the maximum velocity of the ejected electrons.

The radius of our Sun is $6.96\times10^8\,\mathrm{m}$, and its total power output is $3.85\times10^{26}\,\mathrm{W}$. Assuming that the Sun’s surface emits as a black body, calculate its surface temperature.
Show that the wave function of a particle trapped in a finite potential well decays exponentially with distance outside the well.
